lane: LANE S3 — the aggregate-of-call-results emission: wall-B's S3 shape (derive(Default) on a Copy struct — nullary calls whose results are the returned aggregate's fields) becomes the TWELFTH whole-body marker plan; sixteen of the seventeen gap bodies reach -O3
question: Wave-WB8 measured BinderData::default's built model and deferred the twelfth plan as drafted-but-unvalidated (crystal_wb8_chain_emission_2026-08-21.json, S3). The GAP2 census sized the family in the residual -O0/-O3 gap. Land the plan to the WB8 standard: what converts at -O3, what still refuses, and why — measured.
method: Detached trust worktrees at origin/main 11a8e1877a plus the two commits of origin/land/fix-xpy-check-and-pins cherry-picked (ae7df2cdd8 restores the `reflect_rec` module a613e62eb0 cited but never committed — without it NO origin/main commit after the 9fc06acc40 reformat builds — and 3613191dc4 refreshes crates/Cargo.lock for the trust-sha2/trust-hmac swap): subject wt and control wt-base at the SAME sha (TREE clean on both seals, cargo metadata --locked resolves). clean submodule b4808f00c, sysroot-v13 (4-fact sysrootcheck OK both drivers), METADATA_VERSION 13, mir_differential frozen (pin 709a7794). CONTROL sealed from the pristine tree; SUBJECT = control + (1) the aggregate-of-call-results plan (plan_agg_call_markers = agg_call_skeleton over the trust-ir and the producer's struct table + agg_call_source_admits over the HIR — a struct literal in declaration order or a tuple-struct constructor call, every field a bare nullary path call; refuses any struct-typed field), (2) its whole-body predicted walk predict_agg_call (one live per call destination at its own block head, the aggregate assign's use-site keys at block n position 0, reverse-creation-order retirement; slot types from StructDef.fields[k].ty via ir_ty_token), (3) the emitter: a marked destination temp minted in the Inst::Call arm's pre-step and the retirement after the Return arm's aggregate assign (fail-closed: any plan/emitter disagreement is unsup), (4) MfPlans::seal takes the body's own module (the struct table) — the pin test's two spellings updated to the four-argument form, counts unchanged, and (5) SatPerturb::ChainRetOrder re-used as this class's retirement-order control (set only for two or more temps; counted through agg_perturb_applied). No flip.rs change: the marked call-destination locals are scalars or fieldless Copy enums, both admitted by the existing storage-marker gate.
